mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ai_slo_notification_task (id, tenant_id, event_id, alert_id, policy_id, event_type, title, content, status, attempts, next_attempt_at_ms, lease_until_ms, recipient_count, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{eventId}, #{alertId}, #{policyId}, #{eventType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{attempts}, #{nextAttemptAtMs}, #{leaseUntilMs}, #{recipientCount}, #{createdAtMs}, #{updatedAtMs})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_slo_notification_task WHERE (status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at_ms <= #{nowMs}) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until_ms < #{nowMs}) ORDER BY created_at_ms, id LIMIT #{limit}
